title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Data Center Expert XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Data Center Expert. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the exportSvg method. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root.
